name: Avan Geiserford
source:
Stoic and seemingly intimidating, Avan Geiserford holds the position of Student Council President at Olympus University, an impressive achievement for a sophomore who is also a member of the swim team. While he tends to keep to himself, Avan has an earnest and sincere nature with those he trusts. However, there's an intriguing side of him he's been eager to show, which leads to his involvement in a club like Jock Studio.
